messages:
jess_cs: Drafting a tiny customer-facing priming note for OrchidLabs (renewal demo). Want it ultra-skim: prep, live knobs, consent, and quick rollback. PTAL.

mike_eng: Post the one-liner checklist we can hand to AE.

jess_cs: One-liner checklist for AE: 
- Goal: make demo feel instant and repeatable.
- Owners: CS (jess_cs) + Eng (mike_eng).
- 48h: reserve warm pool sized to 95pct expected concurrency.
- 6h: run prefill job with demo prompts + any custom system prompts.
- 1h: dry-run full flow with streaming on.

Live knobs to recommend to customer:
- prefill_ttl_sec=3600
- batch_hint: {batch_size:8, max_latency_ms:50}
- enable_stream=true, stream_fallback_ms=180

Observability checks: confirm first-byte <150ms and collect 3 traces.
Feedback: 3-question survey + opt-in to attach up to 2 anonymized transcripts (consent: "I consent to anonymized transcript review"). Link: tiny.redwood/feedback-orchid

Rollback/escalation: if 95th latency >220ms OR hallucination rate rises -> switch to fallback model variant, abort prefill, notify CS-oncall and infra.

olivia_ae: Add a one-sentence AE risk line: "Risk: renewal sensitive to latency/quality; mitigation: warm-pools, prefill, rollback plan."

raj_support: Prefill curl for ops:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/prefill \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"tenant":"orchidlabs","prompt":"demo-warm","pool_size":10,"ttl_sec":3600}'
```

scheduling_bot: Automated: reserve dedicated slot 2024-11-23T11:00:00Z for tenant 'orchidlabs' " . Reply :thumbsup: to confirm.
